Save Your GTA 6 Day Off for November 20 Instead of Launch Day | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: Taking November 20 off for GTA 6 could mean more playtime and less setup than launch day if you only have one day of leave.
articles.txt:
It feels like most of the internet, A-list models/celebrities and professional drivers included, has already booked the days up to and including November 19 off work for Grand Theft Auto VI . So, for those who haven't yet, the FOMO is real, but what if you didn't follow the tide? Hear us out. What if the better pick for most adults to take the day off for GTA 6 is on November 20?
For all of Rockstar Games ' preparations, launch day will likely be a mess of midnight unlocks, last-minute downloads and hammered servers. The day after is when you can sit down and properly play the biggest game in years .
You see, GTA 6 unlocks at midnight in your local time , which sounds great until you remember what midnight means. New Zealand goes first and North America goes nearly last, a spread of around 19 hours, so a US player who booked the 19th off is really looking at a game that drops in the dead middle of the night before. You either stay up like a student or you start your day-off groggy and behind.
Then there is the download size. GTA 6 is a roughly 210 GB install . With releases this size, part of the download often unlocks only at the moment it goes live, and a day-one patch is common. Whether GTA 6 follows that script, we will find out at midnight. What's a sure thing is that on launch night, millions of Grand Theft Auto fans will download at once. The expected traffic is even making internet service providers like Spectrum hand out free gigabit speed .
Launch day itself is historically rough, at least online. Rockstar’s servers buckle at the best of times. A global GTA 6 launch is not the best of times. The bet is that a day later the crush has thinned, any patch is in and the game runs closer to how it is meant to. Nothing is guaranteed, Rockstar launches can stay messy for more than a day, but the odds may have improved by then.
Besides, a day off work is precious, so you'll want to spend it playing. If you book it on November 19, you may have to download, patch and pray to the internet gods that it won't take you hours to enjoy GTA 6 . However, if you follow our advice, you could preload and download GTA 6 while you're at work and wake up the next day to a finished install, calmer servers and a clean run at Vice City with nothing left to set up.
Booking November 20 off means most of the download times, the patch and the server chaos are no longer that big of an issue.
There is a real case for the 19th, to be fair. Midnight unlocks are sort of a longstanding gaming tradition and the launch-night energy is part of the fun. If you can pre-load and pull an all-nighter, nothing beats being there at the jump. Spoilers are the other worry , because the game will be everywhere online within hours, so waiting a day means dodging a lot of it. If that is you, take both days and enjoy every minute. For everyone else who can't afford to take more than a single day of leave , though, the maths favours the morning after.
Make no mistake, actual and normal people are rationing their leave for this. HR data shows a time-off surge that Grand Theft Auto V had never caused, one company is closing entirely for launch and an analyst has estimated that the game could cost the US economy a billion dollars in a day and so much more .
So our recommendation is to clock in as you would on launch day, go on a social media blackout and spend the day after in Leonida with a better chance of GTA 6 being fully downloaded and the servers behaving. You will have waited eleven years . What's one more day of self-control, right?

articles.txt:
Alors que la sortie de GTA 6 approche enfin, voici comment éviter de vous faire spoiler massivement autour du nouveau titre ultra attendu de Rockstar Games.
13 ans après GTA 5 , on s'apprête enfin ce 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series avec GTA 6 à retourner à Vice City 24 ans après l'épisode qui lui a donné naissance à la sauce années 80, pour voir comment s'en sort cette version fictive de Miami à une époque moderne. Pour ce nouveau tour de piste dans l'État de Leonida, nous allons l'explorer en compagnie de Lucia et Jason au sein d'une toute nouvelle histoire, avec ce qui se présente sous tous rapports comme le jeu ultime de Rockstar Games. Histoire d'éviter tout spoiler intempestif pour profiter au mieux de l'un des jeux les plus attendus de ces dernières années, qui va fatalement beaucoup faire parler de lui, voici quelques précautions à prendre.
Cela fait déjà depuis plusieurs années que GTA 6 et Rockstar ont malheureusement fait les frais de l'énorme attente autour du titre avec plusieurs hacks massifs qui ont entraîné des leaks très dommageables pour le jeu et ses développeurs. Depuis quelques mois, c'est le groupe Cyberleek qui fait transpirer à grosses gouttes le studio écossais en leakant du gameplay, et en affirmant posséder une version complètement jouable du début à la fin de GTA 6, qu'il pourrait soit-disant partager à tout moment si Rockstar et Take-Two ne répondent pas à ses exigences.
À ce titre, méfiez-vous fortement des personnes prétendant connaître « la fin complète » du jeu ou posséder une version piratée téléchargeable, qui pourrait être une énorme arnaque, voire pire un fichier infecté par un dangereux virus.
Au-delà des menaces de Cyberleek, des leaks et spoilers de GTA 6 provenant d'autres sources risquent de continuer d'affluer d'ici à sa sortie ce 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series. Il apparaît donc urgent de se prémunir de tout cela autant que possible si vous souhaitez découvrir l'aventure de Lucia et Jason dans l'État de Leonida tranquillement et vous garder l'effet de surprise sur leur histoire ou des nouveautés jusqu'alors gardées secrètes.
La chose est d'autant plus importante pour les joueurs PC, qui devront encore plus ronger leur frein pour jouer à GTA 6, malgré plusieurs rumeurs laissant entendre qu'un portage PC du jeu pourrait arriver dans les prochains mois, au lieu d'un an et plus comme ce fut le cas pour les précédents jeux de Rockstar.
Afin d'éviter les spoilers autour de GTA 6, la méthode la plus efficace reste de masquer les mots-clés liés à l'histoire du jeu, jusqu'à ce que vous ayez vu le générique de fin. Pensez à ajouter chaque terme dans ses deux variantes, « GTA 6 » et « GTA VI », en anglais comme en français. À noter qu'en général la plupart des leaks circulent d'abord en anglais.

articles.txt:
À moins de deux semaines de sa sortie, Grand Theft Auto VI se dévoile progressivement. Après plusieurs bandes-annonces, l’inaccessible studio américain Rockstar Games a levé le voile sur de nombreux aspects de ce nouvel épisode, attendu le 19 novembre en France et dans le reste du monde. Monde ouvert deux fois plus vaste que celui de son prédécesseur, duo de braqueurs, réseaux sociaux omniprésents et environnements particulièrement détaillés… Le studio promet une nouvelle étape pour cette franchise devenue l’une des plus populaires de l’histoire du jeu vidéo. Voici ce que l’on sait de cet opus, treize ans après la sortie de GTA V .
Certains se souviennent sans doute du lancement de GTA en 1997. La série met en scène des criminels évoluant dans des métropoles américaines fictives, sur fond de braquages, de trafics et de satire de la société contemporaine. GTA VI repose sur deux personnages principaux, à savoir Jason Duval, ancien militaire ayant servi dans l’armée avant de travailler pour des trafiquants de drogue dans les Keys, et Lucia Caminos, qui a été incarcérée au pénitencier de Leonida. Leur rencontre les entraîne dans une conspiration criminelle à l’échelle de l’État fictif. Rockstar revendique une histoire inspirée de l’imaginaire de Bonnie and Clyde , le célèbre couple de braqueurs américains.
Pour la première fois dans un épisode principal en 3D de la franchise, une femme partage ainsi le premier rôle avec un personnage masculin. Les joueurs pourront passer de Jason à Lucia et mener certaines activités ensemble ou séparément. Leur relation constitue l’un des ressorts narratifs du jeu, les deux protagonistes devant notamment apprendre à se faire confiance pour survivre dans un environnement criminel. Autour d’eux gravite une galerie de personnages hauts en couleur. Cal Hampton, un ami de Jason, est un adepte des théories du complot qui préfère observer le monde depuis son domicile. Boobie Ike, figure de la vie nocturne de Vice City, a bâti un empire mêlant immobilier, club de strip-tease et studio d’enregistrement. Il s’associe notamment à Dre’Quan Priest, un entrepreneur qui cherche à percer dans l’industrie musicale. Les deux rappeuses Bae-Luxe et Roxy, qui forment le duo Real Dimez, complètent cette galerie. Amies depuis le lycée, elles ont développé leur notoriété grâce à des morceaux de rap et à une présence particulièrement active sur les réseaux sociaux.
L’action se situe dans l’État fictif de Leonida, inspiré de la Floride, avec Vice City comme principale métropole. Cette ville, déjà au cœur d’un épisode sorti en 2002, reprend les codes de Miami avec ses plages, ses palmiers, ses quartiers résidentiels, sa vie nocturne et son architecture Art déco. Mais le terrain de jeu ne se limite pas à la ville. Rockstar a présenté six grandes régions : Vice City, les îles des Leonida Keys, les marécages de Grassrivers, la ville côtière de Port Gellhorn, la zone industrielle d’Ambrosia et le parc national de Mount Kalaga. De fait, la carte se veut environ deux fois plus vaste que celle de GTA V , sorti en 2013. Rockstar insiste surtout sur sa densité : les intérieurs, les ruelles et les toits ont fait l’objet d’un travail approfondi, avec davantage de bâtiments accessibles. Détail pas si anecdotique : l’environnement promet également une grande diversité animale, avec plus de 170 espèces annoncées, des oiseaux aux mammifères, en passant par les reptiles et les poissons. La météo évoluera au fil des parties, avec des précipitations et des effets sur les paysages, notamment les flaques et les surfaces mouillées.
Pour le reste, les braquages, les courses-poursuites, les fusillades et les trafics resteront au cœur de l’expérience. Les joueurs pourront préparer des opérations criminelles, cambrioler des commerces et échapper aux forces de l’ordre, dont les réactions tiendront davantage compte du comportement des personnages et des témoins présents sur les lieux. Mais Rockstar entend aussi multiplier les activités annexes : plongée sous-marine, kayak, courses automobiles, billard, parachutisme, mini-golf ou encore séances de sport. Les joueurs pourront également faire du jet-ski, pratiquer des activités nautiques et explorer les différents environnements de Leonida. Les PNJ doivent réagir de manière plus crédible à leur environnement. articles.t: GTA 6 Achievement Leak Claims 55 Entries, One Worth 1,000
articles.chapeau: A forum leak says GTA 6 has 55 achievements, more than GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar has not confirmed it, and no names or requirements are known.
articles.txt:
Prague 3° Cloudy Exchange rate EUR 24,35 USD 21,80 Petrol / Diesel 41,28 · 46,91 Kč Popular today at 09:45 News Science & Space Dwarf Galaxies Have Lost Most of Their Oxygen, Hubble Study of 37 Finds today at 09:30 News Economy Babiš and Schillerová want to raise the mortgage tax deduction for young people today at 09:20 News World Trump Says Ukraine Will Emerge Reshaped as Abu Dhabi Peace Talks Near today at 09:05 News U.S. GTA 6 Achievement Leak Claims 55 Entries, One Worth 1,000 today at 08:55 News World Kraków shooter dies in hospital after three operations A leak circulating among Grand Theft Auto fans claims that GTA 6 will ship with 55 achievements and trophies, more than Rockstar Games included in GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar has not confirmed the figure, and the game's official trophy and achievement lists have not been published.
For completionists, the leak offers a number but little else: no achievement names, no unlock requirements and no sense of difficulty. The game is due Nov. 19, 2026, according to eGamers.io.
According to eGamers.io, the leak says GTA 6 has 55 achievements in total. Of those, 54 reportedly carry point values from 1 to 54, while the last is valued at 1,000. MMOEXP reported the same breakdown.
Fans have fixated on the 1,000-value entry. One theory, reported by eGamers.io, is that it rewards finishing every other achievement, which would make it a Platinum Trophy on PS5 or a Mythic Achievement on Xbox Series X|S. MMOEXP also called it likely to be a "complete all other achievements" entry or a platinum placeholder. eGamers.io cautioned that the values could be placeholders that Rockstar changes before release, or could mean nothing.
eGamers.io traced the claim to a member of a GTA fan forum who goes by Tex2, also using the name TexFunz2. Accounts in the wider GTA community on social media then spread the post.
The outlet stressed that this is leaked, unverified information. It said the 55-achievement figure should be treated with caution until Rockstar releases the official lists.
eGamers.io said the base PS5 trophy list for GTA 5 has 51 trophies, but only 33 relate to offline play. The rest come from GTA Online objectives and the Platinum Trophy.
Red Dead Redemption 2 follows a similar pattern, according to the same report. Of its 52 PlayStation trophies, 34 are tied to the single-player game, with Red Dead Online achievements and the Platinum Trophy making up the remainder.
If the GTA 6 list covered only single-player content, which eGamers.io called a big assumption, its 54 regular achievements would be close to double the single-player trophy count of either older game. The outlet added that an achievement total alone does not show how much content a game contains.
For now, very little can be said with certainty. eGamers.io suggested a larger list could point to more activities, collectibles, side missions and challenges, but it presented that as a possibility rather than a known fact.
The leak does not say how hard the achievements will be or how long a full completion might take, according to eGamers.io. MMOEXP noted that specific achievement details have not been revealed.
MMOEXP also warned that if detailed lists leak later, they may contain story spoilers, and said players who care about the narrative may want to avoid related discussions.
The next confirmation would come when Rockstar publishes the official trophy and achievement lists. eGamers.io noted the timing of the leak is unusual, with the game close to its Nov. 19, 2026, release date. Until then, the figures rest on a single forum user's claim.

articles.t: GTA 6 : l'information que les joueurs Xbox attendaient vient enfin de tomber
articles.chapeau: Depuis le début de la communication autour de GTA 6, on ne parle que de la version PS5. Et pourtant, le jeu de Rockstar sort aussi sur Xbox Series. Et
articles.txt:
Depuis le début de la communication autour de GTA 6 , on ne parle que de la version PS5. Et pourtant, le jeu de Rockstar sort aussi sur Xbox Series. Et justement, l’une des informations que les joueurs de la console de Microsoft attendaient vient enfin de tomber.
Le Xbox Store indique que GTA 6 demandera 209,86 Go sur Xbox Series, soit un poids très proche de la version PS5. Rockstar évoque jusqu’à 212 Go pour le préchargement, alors qu’une boîte PS5 mentionne de son côté 230 Go minimum. Le préchargement commencera le 10 novembre 2026, plusieurs jours avant la sortie de GTA 6 fixée au 19 novembre. On peut le dire, on a l’impression que GTA 6 est une exclusivité PS5 tant Xbox communique très peu à son propos . Et puis n’oublions pas que Rockstar a fait le choix de montrer les trailers sur la version PS5, tout comme la présentation de 27 minutes sur Netflix . Bref, Microsoft a l’air quelque peu à l’écart de la communication et des fuites.
Mais aujourd’hui, on parle enfin de la version Xbox Series puisque, alors que le poids de GTA 6 sur PS5 est connu , c’est celui sur la console de Microsoft qui vient d’être dévoilé. Le Xbox Store affiche 209,86 Go demandés pour installer GTA 6. De son côté, Rockstar parle d’un maximum de 212 Go d’espace pour le fichier de préchargement selon la console.
🟩| GTA 6’s size on XBOX SERIES X|S according to the XBOX Store database, via @Cokymoky69 ▪️ The global version is approximately [ 225.34GB ] ▪️ The Australian version is approximately [ 225.34GB ] ▪️ The Japanese version is approximately [ 224.14GB ] #GTA6 #GTAVI pic.twitter.com/3kYSsPXZlv
Si l’on en croit ces chiffres, les poids des versions PS5 et Xbox Series de GTA 6 sont donc autour de 210 Go . Des images capturées chez un revendeur allemand montrent toutefois une boîte PS5 avec la mention de 230 Go minimum. Alors pourquoi un écart aussi grand avec les 210 Go évoqués précédemment ? Peut-être est-ce une première mise à jour qui s’installera au lancement et demandera quelques Go.
Rappelons que tous les joueurs sont logés à la même enseigne, qu’ils soient sur PS5 ou Xbox Series. Et pour cause, pas de version physique pour le jeu de Rockstar et Take-Two, l’éditeur du studio, assume pleinement ce choix .
Une partie des joueurs a décidé de boycotter GTA 6 pour cette raison , mais pas sûr que leur poids suffise face au raz-de-marée qui s’annonce le 19 novembre prochain alors que Rockstar vient tout juste de dévoiler 39 images 4K de GTA 6 .
C’est le 10 novembre 2026 que le préchargement débutera à minuit sur PS5 en France et sur Xbox Series à 1 heure du matin , toujours chez nous. À l’origine, Rockstar avait fixé la date au 12 novembre avant de l’avancer de 48 heures. De quoi permettre à ceux qui ont une connexion très lente d’avoir plusieurs jours devant eux pour que tout soit prêt à la sortie officielle de GTA 6.
Pour les joueurs qui ont notamment une PS5 standard avec ses 667 Go sur le SSD interne, GTA 6 prendra donc plus d’un tiers de l’espace . Rien d’étonnant lorsque l’on voit à quel point le réalisme a été poussé à son maximum, que ce soit en termes de graphismes, de gameplay, d’ambition artistique ou encore de personnages non joueurs .
Si GTA 6 sortira d’abord sur PS5 et Xbox Series , on s’attend à ce que la version PC sorte rapidement, sans doute en début d’année 2027 selon les rumeurs . Pour le moment, la meilleure console pour jouer à GTA 6 n’est autre que la PS5 Pro, qui bénéficie d’une certification d’optimisation pour la console de Sony .

articles.txt:
Looking to buy the biggest game of all time but want to save a bit of money? Well, if you have a willing friend in tow, you should look into how to game share Grand Theft Auto 6 with another person on PS5 or Xbox Series X & S, allowing two people to play using a single digital purchase.
Game sharing works by letting another console access games purchased through your account. Both players can then use their own profiles, including for GTA Online, though it’s obviously not been confirmed for GTA 6’s version of it.
Your friend should now be able to play GTA 6 using their own account, while you play on your own PS5 using the account that purchased the game.
Important: You can only enable Console Sharing and Offline Play on one PS5 at a time.
Your friend can then play your digital copy of GTA 6, while you play on your own console using your purchasing account.
Xbox limits how frequently you can change your Home Xbox, so avoid switching it unnecessarily.
Yes , assuming GTA 6 follows the usual game-sharing rules, both players will be able to play GTA 6 at the same time, even with just one digital copy.
This works on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with each person playing on their own console and account. You should even be able to play GTA Online together, provided you both have the necessary online subscriptions.
Game sharing GTA 6 is a pretty handy way to save some money, especially if you and a mate are both planning to pick it up at launch. Splitting the cost of one copy is obviously better than paying full price twice, but there are a few drawbacks. You’ll need to trust whoever you’re sharing with, and changing your primary console can cause issues with accessing your other games.
Game sharing works with pretty much every digital game on PS5 and Xbox, so GTA 6 should be no exception. It’s usually DLC where things get a bit confusing, as certain expansions, in-game currencies and pre-order bonuses can be tied to individual accounts. Fortnite, for instance. Still, it’s a decent way to make GTA 6 a bit more affordable.

Now, a fresh leak has revealed references to online features in the game's release build.
The discovery suggests that Rockstar Games may have already laid the groundwork for multiplayer functionality. While this does not confirm an early launch, it offers a new clue about when GTA 6 Online could arrive.
GTA 6 Online could arrive sooner than some fans expect, according to a new discovery in the game's release build. PlayStation Game Size (@PlaystationSize on X) has reportedly spotted references to multiplayer functionality in PlayStation's backend data.
The leaked code includes strings such as joinSession , launchActivity , and launchMultiplayerActivity . These references suggest that Rockstar Games may already be preparing the groundwork for online gameplay.
The discovery does not confirm that Grand Theft Auto 6 Online will be available on launch day. Rockstar's official PlayStation listing describes Grand Theft Auto 6 as a single-player experience. However, the presence of multiplayer-related references suggests that the studio could introduce online features through a future update.
Interestingly, GTA 5 received its online mode around two weeks after its initial release. Red Dead Redemption 2 also introduced its online beta roughly a month after launch. This has raised hopes that Rockstar could follow a similar approach with Grand Theft Auto 6.

articles.t: TTWO Posts Its Best Week In 5 Months As Investors Expect Bumper Forecasts Ahead Of GTA VI Launch
articles.chapeau: Investors and analysts expect noteworthy updates on ‘GTA VI,’ which releases on Nov. 19.
articles.txt:
TTWO Posts Its Best Week In 5 Months As Investors Expect Bumper Forecasts Ahead Of GTA VI Launch Yuvraj Malik Mon, November 9, 2026 at 8:30 AM GMT+1 3 min read TTWO 0.00% Take-Two said it saw "unprecedented" demand for "GTA VI" in August, after opening pre-orders for the game in June.
Analysts expect Take-Two's Q2 to decline 16% to $1.66 billion.
Take-Two Interactive, Inc. (TTWO) posted its best week in nearly five months last week as investors set their positions ahead of the gaming company's fiscal second-quarter report due after market hours on Monday.
Take-Two is expected to share more details about 'Grand Theft Auto VI,' one of the most anticipated game releases in years, ahead of its Nov. 19 launch, and may even reveal pre-order figures.

In August, the company said it was seeing "unprecedented" demand for the title, though it kept its fiscal ⁠2027 bookings outlook unchanged at $8 billion to $8.20 billion at the time. Pre-orders for 'GTA VI' started on June 25.
At the time, Take-Two projected September-quarter bookings between $1.62 billion and $1.67 billion, below market estimates, signaling continued weakness due to the lack of fresh titles outside of "GTA.'
The current version of the game, 'GTA V,' is one of the best-selling games of all time, with over 230 million ‌units ⁠sold since its 2013 launch. "GTA VI" will be available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S at launch.
TTWO stock rose 13% last week and was up 1.3% in overnight trading ahead of Monday.
Last week, Macquarie initiated coverage on TTWO with an 'Outperform' rating and a $300 price target, which implies a 40% upside from the stock's last close. The investment research firm said Take-Two was entering a multi-year period of accelerating earnings growth and free cash flow generation driven by the 'GTA VI' launch.
On the other hand, BTIG lowered its price target on the stock to $262 from $313 to reflect softer Mobile data and a reduction in its NBA 2K forecasts. On average, analysts expect Take-Two's Q2 to decline 16% to $1.66 billion and adjusted profit to drop 33% to $0.97 per share, per Koyfin.
TTWO was among the top trending tickers on Stocktwits at the time of writing, with a 'bullish' retail sentiment.
"$TTWO is down 17.7% since its last report, and management called GTA VI pre-orders unprecedented. GTA V has sold over 200M units since 2013," a trader said .
Another said, "GTA VI launches Nov 19 and fiscal 2027 net bookings guide is $8B to $8.2B, about 20% growth. Operating cash flow expected above $1B. Buying before the biggest launch in gaming at this price."
One more trader wrote , "Get ready for earnings. Most likely we drop unless Strauss drops the pre-order numbers. In any case I think we'll recover within a day or two and shoot for a new 52wk high before release."

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 is still some time away from launch, but new PlayStation database findings have drawn attention to its planned multiplayer features.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 is still some time away from launch, but new PlayStation database findings have highlighted its planned multiplayer features. The current PS5 version reportedly includes functionality to join sessions and start multiplayer activities, suggesting Rockstar Games is already preparing online features ahead of the game's eventual release.
However, this doesn't confirm that GTA 6 Online is playable or that it is near release. But they do give an early indication of how multiplayer functionality is being integrated into the game. With Rockstar yet to announce an official release date or provide information about its online plans, the scope of these preparations remains unclear.
Earlier reports offered a possible picture of what GTA 6 Online could include . In 2025, a leak described a multiplayer project known internally as GTA 6 MP, with lobbies planned for 64 players instead of GTA Online's 32. It also suggested Rockstar was considering support for up to 96 players at a later stage of development.
The same leak described technology intended to make switching between singleplayer and multiplayer smoother. It also suggested players could join free-mode activities across several sessions without lengthy loading screens or manual invitations. These features were presented as development plans, however, and Rockstar has not officially confirmed the reported player counts or session systems.
PlayStation database entries reveal GTA 6 multiplayer functions. The latest information comes from PS Game Size, which identified the current GTA 6 PS5 version as 1.001.004. Its report listed three functions: intent type join session, intent type launch activity, and intent type launch multiplayer activity. Their presence suggests the game already references actions associated with online sessions and multiplayer activities.
PS Game Size also reported that additional content packs are handled through license files and require only a one-megabyte download. These reportedly cover pre-order rewards and Ultimate Edition bonuses. The system could allow eligible content to be accessed across accounts on the same PS5, although Rockstar has not publicly explained how these licenses work on the console.
Database references to online functionality show that certain features are being prepared, but they do not confirm that GTA 6 Online is finished, accessible, or supported by active servers. These entries only show that backend groundwork is underway, without revealing when any of these features will be enabled for players.
Furthermore, these database entries provide no evidence that previously leaked features such as expanded lobby sizes or seamless session transitions are finalized. Until Rockstar confirms details, the launch date, server status, and final multiplayer features remain unconfirmed. Twitch's CEO has made comments that have raised expectations for a 2027 launch.
Rockstar has not announced a release date for GTA 6 Online , but comments by Twitch CEO Dan Clancy have fuelled expectations of a 2027 launch. During a 2026 Bloomberg interview, Clancy reportedly said that an even bigger period would follow GTA 6's launch the next year, when its multiplayer component arrives. His remarks did not provide further technical details.
Those comments are the main reason 2027 is being discussed, but they do not specify a month or season. Some have speculated about an early-year launch, while others expect the mode could arrive in summer. Neither possibility has been confirmed, and the database discovery doesn't narrow the release window. For now, both remain unverified possibilities. GTA Online's financial success makes the next multiplayer launch important.
GTA Online has become a major recurring revenue source for Rockstar and parent company Take-Two Interactive, making the next multiplayer launch commercially important. However, that financial incentive does not necessarily mean Rockstar will rush its release. Stability might be a priority for the studio, especially after the first GTA Online had server and access issues at launch.
The database entries offer the most tangible evidence yet that Rockstar is getting ready for multiplayer in Grand Theft Auto 6. Earlier leaks and industry comments have provided helpful background information, but the developer still needs to confirm critical details like the final player caps, feature set, and official release schedule.

articles.t: GTA 6 pourrait arriver plus vite sur PC à cause des clones faits par IA qui pullulent
articles.chapeau: Rockstar a toujours fait patienter les joueurs PC, parfois plus d’un an et demi. Pour GTA 6, ce délai pourrait fondre sous la pression d’une menace inattendue. Un ancien directeur technique du studio la juge assez sérieuse pour bousculer le calendrier du jeu le plus attendu de la décennie.
articles.txt:
Rockstar a toujours fait patienter les joueurs PC, parfois plus d’un an et demi. Pour GTA 6, ce délai pourrait fondre sous la pression d’une menace inattendue. Un ancien directeur technique du studio la juge assez sérieuse pour bousculer le calendrier du jeu le plus attendu de la décennie.
Obbe Vermeij, directeur technique de Rockstar North jusqu’en 2009, pense que l’IA générative pourrait pousser Rockstar à sortir la version PC de GTA 6 plus tôt que prévu. Dans un entretien accordé vendredi à Rock Paper Shotgun et relayé par Dexerto , il craint que des bidouilleurs convertissent la version PS5 pour ordinateur grâce à l’IA. Le jeu sort le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series, et aucune version PC n’est encore annoncée.
“Si j’étais Rockstar, je craindrais que quelqu’un prenne la version PS5 et demande à une IA de la convertir pour PC. Le résultat ne vaudrait pas leur travail, mais il pourrait quand même nuire à leurs ventes” , explique celui qui a travaillé sur GTA 3, Vice City, San Andreas et GTA 4. Il avoue ignorer les plans du studio. En revanche, il ne serait pas surpris que Rockstar resserre l’écart entre consoles et PC.
L’opération n’aurait rien d’une promenade de santé. Vermeij chiffre la note à plusieurs dizaines de milliers de dollars rien qu’en jetons d’IA, auxquels s’ajoutent de longues heures de travail. Take-Two dispose aussi de solides arguments juridiques pour attaquer. Le vétéran reste pourtant convaincu que quelqu’un tentera sa chance, tant le nom de GTA attire.
Chez Rockstar, l’attente se compte d’ordinaire en saisons : dix-neuf mois pour GTA V, environ treize pour Red Dead Redemption 2. Selon GamesBeat, la version PC de GTA 6 viserait le premier trimestre 2027 . L’analyste Michael Pachter, lui, table plutôt sur mai ou juin .
Rockstar n’a rien confirmé. En attendant, les joueurs sur console peuvent préparer le terrain : le préchargement de GTA 6 ouvre le 12 novembre .

articles.t: GTA 6 : les mots à bloquer sur les réseaux dès maintenant pour éviter les spoilers

articles.txt:
Avec GTA 6, un scroll de trop peut ruiner une mort, une trahison ou la fin. Voici les mots à masquer et les réflexes à adopter avant la déferlante.
Le vrai risque avec GTA 6 , il est là, un simple scroll peut vous balancer une mort, une trahison ou la dernière cinématique sans prévenir. Et vu la taille du lancement, ça ne va pas rester coincé dans deux forums obscurs.
Si vous regardez déjà du jeu vidéo, les plateformes sociales vous connaissent par cœur. Recherches, vidéos vues, comptes suivis, tout remonte. Résultat, des contenus liés à Rockstar Games peuvent surgir dans le feed avant même que vous les cherchiez, avec au passage un spoil sur l’histoire de Jason et Lucia , une scène finale ou un twist de scénario. Pas besoin d’être plongé dans les communautés gaming pour s’en prendre un.
Le pire, c’est que la popularité de GTA 6 dépasse largement le public habituel. Même des gens qui parlent rarement jeux vidéo vont en croiser. Clairement, attendre les premières fuites pour réagir, c’est déjà trop tard.
Sur le réseau social X , vous pouvez masquer des mots-clés, des expressions et des hashtags. Faites-le maintenant, et pas seulement avec le titre du jeu, parce que les posts les plus toxiques évitent souvent de l’écrire franchement.
Pensez aussi aux variantes en GTA 6 au lieu de GTA VI , même chose pour les langues avec le français ou encore l’espagnol. C’est basique, mais ça réduit déjà pas mal la casse.
Là, le filtrage montre ses limites. Sur YouTube , une miniature suffit à flinguer une surprise, même sans cliquer. Le bon réflexe, c’est d’éviter les recherches de gameplay, d’utiliser les options « Pas intéressé » ou « Ne pas recommander la chaîne » , et de mettre un peu de distance avec les chaînes gaming pendant un temps.
Même logique sur Reddit . Si vous suivez déjà des communautés autour de GTA 6 , mieux vaut vous désabonner avant que les captures et les discussions spoilantes commencent à tomber .
Aucun filtre ne garantit le zéro spoil. Le seul bouclier vraiment solide, c’est de rester hors ligne, ou au moins de réduire franchement votre présence sur les réseaux et les plateformes vidéo.
Bon, c’est pénible, mais on parle d’un des plus gros lancements de l’histoire du jeu vidéo. Et quand les créateurs vont se battre pour les vues, certains n’auront aucun scrupule à spoiler pour exister.

articles.chapeau: American pilot Benjamin McDaniel has taken fan enthusiasm to dizzying new heights after spending over eight hours in the air using his aircraft to map out a gig
articles.txt:
Copied American pilot Benjamin McDaniel has taken fan enthusiasm to dizzying new heights after spending over eight hours in the air using his aircraft to map out a gigantic Grand Theft Auto VI mural across the sky.
Known online by his moniker ‘ThePilotPicasso’, Benjamin piloted his Cessna Skyplane RG across Arkansas to execute the intricate aerial artwork. Visible to aviation watchers on flight-tracking platform Flightradar24, the sprawling sky-mural features the iconic GTA VI logo rendered underneath a hovering helicopter, accompanied by classic Florida-inspired graphics including a sports car, palm trees, an alligator, and a bikini-clad figure.
The extraordinary flight originated from Bentonville airstrip at 11.29 am, with Benjamin touching down back at the same runway at 7.37 pm after precisely eight hours and eight minutes in the air.
Sharing a time-lapse video of his flight track online, Benjamin reflected on the long wait for the gaming franchise's latest instalment. "I spent 8 hours drawing GTA 6 in the sky, but realistically, I've been waiting 11 years for this moment," Benjamin shared.
Executing such detailed sky-art requires meticulous planning. Benjamin must balance performance limits, precise turns, altitude constraints and location coordinates while ensuring the flight operates completely safely.
The feat quickly caught fire online after Flightradar24 highlighted the flight path mid-journey, inspiring gaming enthusiasts to watch the artwork take shape live. Fans flooded social media with praise, with one viewer writing: "This was awesome to watch! My children even thought it was the coolest thing ever." Another joked: "We got GTA 6 sky art before GTA 6. But seriously, this is so crazy."
This is hardly Benjamin's first skyward masterpiece. He previously captured global attention by replicating world-famous masterpieces with his flight paths, including Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa and Edvard Munch's The Scream .

articles.chapeau: A leak claims Grand Theft Auto 6 has 55 trophies and achievements, one worth 1,000 points. Rockstar has not confirmed it, and launch is Nov. 19.
articles.txt:

That would be more than Rockstar Games included in GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar has not commented, so the figure remains unverified until the official lists appear.
The game is due out on Nov. 19, and Shane the Gamer reported that pre-loading opens globally on Nov. 10.
According to Shane the Gamer, the Xbox number came from a dataminer called TexFunz2, whose data lists 55 achievements configured for the game. Another dataminer, PlayStation Game Size, then reportedly found the same total on the PlayStation side. eGamers.io described the origin differently, saying the claim came from a member of a GTA fan forum who goes by Tex2 or TexFunz2, and that the wider GTA community on social media spread it. Reports therefore differ on whether the PlayStation count was independently found.
Neither leak includes achievement names or unlock requirements. eGamers.io noted that there is no indication of how hard the achievements will be or how long a full completion might take.
The detail drawing the most attention is the scoring. Both outlets said 54 of the achievements carry values from 1 to 54, while the last is valued at 1,000.
Fans have offered two main theories. The 1,000-point entry could reward completing the entire list, which would make it the equivalent of a Platinum Trophy on PS5 or a Mythic Achievement on Xbox. Shane the Gamer described Mythic as Microsoft’s newer tier for players who finish everything in a game, so far used only in Microsoft’s own first-party titles, such as Gears of War: E-Day. A Mythic achievement in a Rockstar game would be the first outside Microsoft’s own studios.
The other possibility is that the values are placeholders that Rockstar will replace before release. Shane the Gamer pointed out that a full Xbox game normally launches with 1,000 Gamerscore in total, so a single 1,000-point entry would use up that whole amount by itself. The outlet said the scoring is therefore likely to change before the list goes public, and that the count of 55 is the more solid part of the leak.
eGamers.io said the base PS5 trophy list for GTA 5 has 51 trophies, of which 33 relate to offline play. The rest come from GTA Online objectives and the Platinum Trophy. Red Dead Redemption 2 has 52 PlayStation trophies, of which 34 are tied to the single-player game, with Red Dead Online achievements and the Platinum making up the remainder.
Shane the Gamer noted that GTA 5’s list kept growing after launch. The PS4 and Xbox One re-release added one more entry, and later GTA Online content brought the total to 78.
Reports describe all 55 GTA 6 entries as single-player objectives, according to Shane the Gamer. Because the leaked list has no names, that point rests on reporting rather than on the data itself. eGamers.io called it a big assumption. If it holds, the 54 regular achievements would be close to double the single-player trophy count of either older game, the outlet said. It added that an achievement total alone does not prove how much content a game contains.
For completionists, the list is the checklist that decides how much a full playthrough demands. A longer single-player list could mean more activities, collectibles, side missions and challenges to finish, according to eGamers.io, though without names or requirements that remains speculation.
The Platinum and Mythic question also affects how players on each platform might measure a full completion. Shane the Gamer noted that in both older games PlayStation had one more trophy than Xbox had achievements, because only PlayStation has a Platinum. GTA 6 reportedly shows the same total of 55 on both platforms, which is part of why the 1,000-point entry stands out.

articles.t: GTA 6 encore non sorti : déjà plus de 751 millions de dollars de précommandes
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 n'est pas encore en rayon que le jeu bat déjà des records de précommandes numériques. Le détail des chiffres, selon Clubic.
articles.txt:
Encore quelques jours à patienter avant de poser enfin les mains sur GTA 6 , mais le jeu a déjà de quoi faire tourner la tête à Rockstar Games. Selon Clubic , qui relaie des estimations du cabinet Sensor Tower, les précommandes numériques du titre auraient déjà généré plus de 751 millions de dollars dans le monde, et ce avant même sa sortie officielle le 19 novembre.
Ce chiffre, arrêté début novembre, ne prend même pas en compte les boîtes achetées en magasin. Rockstar n’a pas confirmé ces données, mais le rythme de progression donne le vertige : en l’espace de trois semaines, le compteur aurait gonflé d’environ 150 millions de dollars, soit plusieurs millions de dollars engrangés chaque jour.
Pour mesurer l’ampleur du phénomène, il faut comparer avec le précédent volet de la saga. À sa sortie en 2013, GTA V avait rassemblé environ 7 millions de précommandes avant son lancement, pour finir par dépasser les 800 millions de dollars de recettes le jour J. D’après les chiffres relayés par Clubic, GTA 6 aurait déjà franchi la barre des 7,7 millions d’exemplaires numériques réservés, un total supérieur à celui de son aîné, et qui se rapproche dangereusement du cap symbolique du milliard de dollars, sans même avoir ouvert ses portes.
De quoi confirmer que l’attente autour du jeu de Rockstar Games ne faiblit pas, même après plusieurs années de teasing et de reports successifs de la date de sortie.
Dans la bataille des consoles, la tendance est sans appel. La PlayStation 5 concentrerait à elle seule environ 74 % des précommandes, avec près de 5,7 millions d’exemplaires réservés pour plus de 550 millions de dollars de recettes. La Xbox Series, de son côté, resterait loin derrière, avec un peu moins de 2 millions de précommandes et environ 190 millions de dollars générés.
Cet écart s’explique en partie par l’historique de la licence, traditionnellement plus associée à l’écosystème Sony, mais aussi par une communication de Rockstar qui a longtemps mis en avant les versions PlayStation dans ses bandes-annonces.
Concrètement, si vous comptez vous lancer dans GTA 6 dès le lancement, mieux vaut anticiper. Le jeu nécessiterait jusqu’à 212 Go d’espace de stockage libre, avec un préchargement ouvert deux jours avant la sortie officielle. De quoi faire le ménage dans votre bibliothèque de jeux à l’avance, surtout si votre console tourne déjà à flux tendu niveau mémoire.
Autre point qui agace une partie des joueurs sur PS5 Pro : aucune confirmation officielle n’a pour l’instant été donnée sur un affichage à 60 images par seconde, un détail qui pourrait peser dans le choix de la plateforme pour les plus exigeants techniquement.
Reste à voir si ces chiffres de précommandes, déjà historiques, se transformeront en records de ventes dès le jour de la sortie. Une chose est sûre : Rockstar Games n’a, pour l’instant, pas eu besoin de vendre une seule boîte physique pour faire exploser ses compteurs.

articles.t: Une version de lancement de GTA 6 ayant fuité laisse penser que le multijoueur en ligne pourrait bientôt être lancé
articles.chapeau: Certaines rumeurs indiquent que le mode en ligne de GTA 6 ne serait pas lancé avant une date ultérieure en 2027. Cependant, un dataminer a divulgué du code provenant de la version prévue pour le lancement, faisant allusion à des fonctionnalités multijoueurs. La rentabilité de GTA Online a fait douter de la volonté de Rockstar d’inciter les joueurs à passer au nouvel opus.
articles.txt:
Alors que les préchargements s’apprêtent à débuter, les dataminers découvrent des indices sur le titre très attendu de Rockstar . PlayStation Game Size a trouvé des traces de fonctionnalités en ligne dans la version de GTA 6 prévue pour sa date de sortie . Si aucun mode multijoueur ne sera disponible le 19 novembre, celui-ci pourrait arriver plus tôt que prévu.
Une enquête sur le backend de PlayStation a révélé des références telles que « joinSession », « launchActivity » et « launchMultiplayerActivity ». Ces chaînes de caractères divulguées indiquent que les joueurs peuvent créer ou rejoindre des sessions et lancer des événements axés sur le multijoueur.
Malgré ces curieuses références dans le code de la version de lancement de GTA 6 , une suite à GTA Online pourrait encore se faire attendre de nombreux mois. Les développeurs ont peut-être préparé le terrain pour intégrer facilement une composante multijoueur à l’avenir. Quoi qu’il en soit, un délai prolongé irait à l’encontre du schéma établi par GTA 5 et Red Dead Redemption 2 .
Avec le précédent Grand Theft Auto , un mode en ligne avait vu le jour deux semaines après le lancement de la campagne solo . De son côté, Red Dead Redemption 2 avait accueilli une version bêta environ un mois après la sortie de ce western en monde ouvert.
En revanche, GTA Online reste lucratif pour Rockstar, qui pourrait hésiter à laisser ses fidèles joueurs de côté. Jason Schreier, journaliste bien informé de Bloomberg , a minimisé les chances de voir le studio annoncer prochainement une suite à ce service. Il a ensuite indiqué que les fans pourraient devoir attendre jusqu'en 2027 pour des missions en coopération.
Dans une interview, Dan Clancy, PDG de Twitch , a expliqué en quoi le jeu profiterait à la plateforme de streaming. Il a toutefois précisé qu'un GTA 6 Online attendu en 2027 entraînerait une hausse plus importante de l'audience. Depuis le rachat de Cfx.re par Rockstar, certains espèrent voir apparaître un mode roleplay populaire, similaire à celui de GTA 5 .
La dernière fuite rappelle aux observateurs des messages dévoilés lors d'une procédure judiciaire concernant un employé de Rockstar. Des historiques de conversations Discord mentionnaient une session de test multijoueur réunissant 32 participants en octobre 2025. Même si la saga de Jason et Lucia reste prioritaire, une alternative au mode solo est prévue.
Les spécialistes de l'exploration de données sont sur le qui-vive alors que les préchargements de GTA 6 du 10 novembre commencent d'abord en Nouvelle-Zélande , à minuit, heure locale. À mesure que les fichiers deviennent accessibles sur les consoles Xbox et PS5 , de nouvelles découvertes semblent inévitables.

articles.t: GTA 6 Online Leak: Build Strings Hint at Multiplayer [2026]
articles.chapeau: New GTA 6 Online leak: build strings hint at multiplayer. See what was found, what it could mean, and how credible it is in 2026.
articles.txt:
Elias Virtanen November 9, 2026 11 min read A fresh datamine of the Grand Theft Auto VI launch build has the fan community asking one question ten days before release: is GTA 6 Online closer than anyone thought? According to a Mezha report relaying Notebookcheck , PlayStation Game Size found traces of online functionality in the release build, including the strings joinSession , launchActivity and launchMultiplayerActivity . Both outlets stress that multiplayer will not be playable on November 19.
That caveat matters. Rockstar Games has described Grand Theft Auto VI as a single-player experience at launch, and no official record gives a date for an online mode. The leak is interesting because it suggests the plumbing exists inside the shipping build. It is not proof that a multiplayer launch is imminent. With the digital preload arriving November 12, as we laid out in our nine-day preload countdown , expect even more file-digging in the coming days.
This analysis separates what is confirmed from what is leaked, walks through the three strings, compares the situation with the GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 launches, and ends with five predictions plus an FAQ. Every unconfirmed item is labeled as such.

The story starts with PlayStation Game Size, a tracker that watches PlayStation backend data. Notebookcheck, which published the original write-up on November 9, 2026, reports that an analysis of that backend surfaced references to online features inside the build intended for launch. Mezha summarized the same finding the same day.
Three strings drew the attention. Taken together, the outlets say, they suggest players could create or join sessions and start multiplayer-focused activities. That is a fair reading of the names, but names are all anyone has. Nobody outside Rockstar has shown what these identifiers do, whether they are live code paths or dormant scaffolding, or which game mode they belong to.
The reports also describe the finding as coming from backend data rather than from a playable build someone ran. That distinction shapes how much weight the leak deserves. Backend entries can list planned features, internal test hooks, or leftovers from earlier development. Treat the find as a clue, not a feature list.
Developers name functions for what they do, so the identifiers hint at intent. The table below pairs each reported string with the reading the outlets offered and the limit of that reading. The interpretation column is analysis, not Rockstar documentation.
The middle string is the weakest evidence on its own. A generic activity launcher could power single-player side content, photo mode challenges, or platform-level features. Only the third string names multiplayer outright, and even it says nothing about timing.
Shipping builds often carry code for features that arrive later. Studios do this to avoid giant day-one patches or to keep one codebase for every mode. When a feature switch flips months after release, dataminers look prescient in hindsight. When the switch never flips, nobody revisits the old headlines. The honest takeaway is that the strings raise the odds of a future online mode without dating it.
The official record is short and consistent. Rockstar Games is the developer and publisher label, and Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is the parent company. The game launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S for $79.99. The setting is the fictional state of Leonida and a modern-day Vice City.
On the date, Rockstar’s own newswire post carries a one-line statement: “Grand Theft Auto VI will now release on Thursday, November 19, 2026.” You can read it on the Rockstar Games newswire . Take-Two’s pre-order announcement set pre-orders to open June 25, 2026 at midnight local time and listed the November 12, 2026 digital preload date.
We keep a running ledger of this split in our confirmed versus rumor scorecard . The new leak lands in the unconfirmed column, as every datamine does until Rockstar speaks.
Both Notebookcheck and Mezha say outright that the multiplayer mode will not be available on launch day. That matches the official description. Nothing in the leak overrides it, and no outlet in this cycle claims otherwise. Anyone telling you the leak proves online play on November 19 is reading more into three strings than the original reporting

articles.txt:
Rockstar Games built Grand Theft Auto VI under global scrutiny, yet one corner of its footprint has stayed quiet for years. Rockstar Leeds , the company’s location in Leeds, England, has been part of Yorkshire’s games industry for more than 20 years, according to Jamie Sefton, managing director of Games Republic. That detail anchors a new Yorkshire Post report asking how the region’s gaming sector could benefit from the game’s arrival.
The story is as much about proximity as it is about money. Sefton and a second industry voice, identified in the report as Ms Fadel, describe a regional scene that has absorbed Rockstar’s influence for two decades. Neither the report nor Rockstar’s own material, however, spells out exactly what the Leeds team does on the new game. That gap shapes everything below.
This analysis separates what The Yorkshire Post and Rockstar’s official material confirm from what experts only expect. It also places the story inside the wider run-up to launch, which our readers have followed through Rockstar’s launch screenshot gallery and the steady stream of leaks. For more platform and studio coverage, see the gaming section .

The core of the Yorkshire Post piece is a regional-economy argument. A major studio with a long local history sits inside a game that the whole industry watches, and local figures want to know whether any of that attention lands in Yorkshire. The paper quotes Jamie Sefton of Games Republic, plus Ms Fadel, who speaks about the community side of the story.
Three claims in the report stand on firm ground. First, Rockstar Leeds exists as a Rockstar Games location in Leeds, a point Rockstar’s own material supports. Second, it has operated in the region for more than 20 years, per Sefton. Third, it played a leading role on smaller Grand Theft Auto titles, namely Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars and Liberty City Stories , according to the paper.

A studio that stays in one city for more than two decades leaves marks that outlast any single release. Staff move between employers, juniors learn on large productions, and veterans eventually start companies of their own. Sefton put it in compact terms, saying Rockstar’s DNA is in the region.
That line carries weight because of who said it. As managing director of Games Republic, he speaks from a senior industry position in the region. We would still read the claim with care. “DNA” is a metaphor, and the report offers no staffing counts or alumni figures to back it up. The sensible reading is qualitative. Rockstar has been a long-running presence, and the regional scene has grown up around it and alongside it.

GTA 6: «Je pourrai plonger dans un autre monde, sans ma maladie»
articles.chapeau: Touché depuis trois ans par une maladie inflammatoire chronique de la peau, Joel se réfugie dans les jeux vidéos et auprès de ses animaux.
articles.txt:
«C’est dur. Ça vous tire vers le bas.» À 20 ans, Joel Kanthak vit depuis trois ans avec de l’acné inversée, une maladie inflammatoire chronique de la peau qui provoque notamment des abcès et des plaies douloureuses. «Quand j’ai appris que je devrais vivre avec toute ma vie, le sol s’est dérobé sous mes pieds.»
Certains jours, la douleur est telle qu’il ne peut même pas se lever. Tandis que les jeunes de son âge étudient, travaillent ou sortent entre amis, Joel passe l’essentiel de son temps chez lui. «Je ne vois mes amis que les bons jours. Mais je suis déjà heureux de ne pas les avoir complètement perdus.»
Le jeune habitant de Dübendorf (ZH) trouve du réconfort dans les jeux vidéo, notamment «Fortnite», où il a noué de nombreuses amitiés. «Quand je joue, j’oublie la douleur.» Il attend aussi avec impatience la sortie de «GTA 6». «Je pourrai plonger dans un autre monde, sans ma maladie.»
Ses animaux lui apportent également du soutien. Il possède des perruches et partage son quotidien avec le chien de la famille. «Il sent quand je vais mal et vient aussitôt se coucher près de moi.»
Mais le regard des autres reste difficile à affronter. «Aller à la piscine ou à l’Alpamare, j’adorais ça quand j’étais enfant. Aujourd’hui, je n’ose plus. J’ai honte de montrer ma peau.» Joel espère un jour dépasser cette gêne et voir la médecine progresser. «Peut-être que cette maladie ne sera plus incurable à l’avenir.»
Le jeune homme encourage les personnes présentant des symptômes similaires à consulter rapidement. «Il ne faut pas avoir honte. La maladie s’installe progressivement, puis elle prend de l’ampleur.»
Il souhaite aussi davantage de compréhension. «Au lieu de me regarder bizarrement, les gens peuvent simplement me poser des questions. Je suis ouvert à en parler.»
Malgré trois ans de traitement antibiotique, Joel affirme que son inflammation reste importante. Les lésions situées à l’aine sont particulièrement douloureuses et perturbent même son sommeil. Il doit disposer des coussins de manière à limiter la pression sur les zones touchées.
Récemment opéré, Joel attend désormais la cicatrisation de sa plaie. Il espère ensuite pouvoir reprendre une activité professionnelle lorsque son état le permettra.
Un lit électrique réglable pourrait lui permettre de dormir plus confortablement. Son père, Fredi Kanthak, 56 ans, a donc lancé une collecte sur GoFundMe , espérant réunir 2000 à 3000 francs.
Fredi, qui bénéficie lui-même de l’assurance invalidité, partage le quotidien difficile de son fils. «À son âge, je sortais et j’allais à des fêtes. Voir qu’il ne peut pas en profiter, ça fait mal.» Malgré tout, Joel garde espoir, soutenu par ses parents. «Je fais de mon mieux. Heureusement, ils sont toujours là pour moi.»
Thomas Sennhauser (ths) travaille pour 20 Minuten depuis 2020. Il a commencé comme journaliste vidéo avant de rejoindre, deux ans plus tard, la rubrique News & Gesellschaft.

articles.t: GTA 5's DJ Cara Actor Has Booked Two Weeks Off to Play GTA 6 | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: Cara Delevingne and Lewis Hamilton say they are clearing time for GTA 6, while Bulkhead is giving its whole team December off.
articles.txt:
Cara Delevingne says she has booked two weeks off to play Grand Theft Auto VI when it arrives on November 19.
The British model and actress, who happens to voice DJ Cara on the pop station in Grand Theft Auto V , says she has booked two full weeks off once the game is out. She is not being shy about why.
"I love that game, I always will," Delevingne said in a red-carpet interview, adding that she still wears her old Grand Theft Auto merch and "booked out two weeks after the game comes out" because "it's gonna be incredible." She is a vocal fan and Rockstar Games once hired her to play a version of herself on the radio.
The role is a real one. Delevingne voices DJ Cara, the hyper, sarcastic British host of Non-Stop-Pop FM at 100.7 in Los Santos, a part she recorded around the 2013 release and returned to for the enhanced versions . It was one of her first proper acting credits, back when she was better known for runways than radio. The clip of her two-weeks-off comment has been passed around.
There is a nice symmetry to it. DJ Cara has reportedly recorded fresh farewell lines for Grand Theft Auto Online , sending players off toward Vice City and teasing a final in-game meetup around November 18. So the same voice telling Los Santos goodbye on the airwaves is the one clearing her schedule to move on. Fans have already turned that farewell into a mass cruise through Los Santos the night before launch , a send-off hosted, fittingly, in DJ Cara's voice.
Previously, when Delevingne was asked if she'd return for the sequel, she gave a laughing "no comment."
Regardless of a potential return, she is in good company. Booking time off for a video game used to be a punchline. Now it's become a trend all over the world . F1 champion Lewis Hamilton says he will cancel work to play it and clear his whole schedule around launch. A games studio, Bulkhead, is giving its entire team December off and telling players to go enjoy it.
It's not a famous-exclusive phenomenon either. HR data shows a GTA 6 time-off surge that GTA 5 never caused .
GTA 6 has famous fans and regular workers alike booking time off, with Cara Delevingne literally in the game.
GTA 6 has famous fans and regular workers alike booking time off, with Cara Delevingne already voicing DJ Cara in GTA 5 .
Delevingne also sits in a longer Rockstar tradition. The studio has a habit of casting real celebrities as radio hosts, from Karl Lagerfeld on Grand Theft Auto IV 's electro station to a string of real DJs across Grand Theft Auto V . Delevingne was the rising-model-turned-host in that group. The rumor is that, another DJ in DJ Khaled, among others , will play a similar role in GTA 6 .
With that said, Delevingne has spent eleven years telling Los Santos what song is coming next. Now she is counting down to Vice City with everyone else, except she gets to hear her own voice say goodbye on the way out.

articles.t: GTA 6 in Japan May Face Cuts Like Earlier Rockstar Games | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's Japanese Xbox build is reportedly about 1.2 GB smaller than the global version, suggesting possible censorship.
articles.txt:
Japan-focused video game columnist @Genki_JPN put words to a worry a lot of players in Japan can relate to over the weekend and the store data suggests that he is right to express his concerns. Grand Theft Auto VI looks set to get a separate, censored Japanese version, the same treatment Rockstar Games has given its games in Japan for many years. Nothing is officially confirmed yet at the moment but history suggests that Grand Theft Auto in Japan is almost always a toned down experience.
At the moment, store backend listings found by dataminers put the global Xbox build of GTA 6 at around 209.86 GiB, in line with the 210 GB download that had been reported for the game and the Japanese CERO Z build at around 208.74 GiB, roughly 1.2 GB smaller. Australia and New Zealand sit almost dead level with the global version, separated by a sliver of metadata, while PlayStation 5 reportedly shows the same worldwide , ANZ and Japan split.
Another tell is the ratings. GTA VI carries Japan's CERO Z label, which is the country's strictest 18-and-over tier, with content icons for crime and violence but, tellingly, none for sexual and nude content or drugs. Grand Theft Auto V had the same luck of the draw, even though we know that the sequel has earned adults-only ratings across every major market and had its sex scenes flagged in rating listings .
CERO Z is the only Japanese rating that legally restricts sales to adults , but it still bars explicit sex, genitalia and the goriest dismemberment, so Rockstar edits its games to pass. GTA V is the most documented case. It has a separate Japanese build with edited sex scenes, Trevor's pants stay on in the pants-drop gag, strip-club dancers dressed down and, most notably, playable torture out of the "By the Book" mission is stripped out completely, fading to black instead.
Other Rockstar titles suffered a similar fate. Red Dead Redemption 2 saw a less gorey release for the Japanese market, with body parts vanishing instead of lingering and brothel scenes keeping their clothes on. Grand Theft Auto IV cut back blood and blocked attacks on downed enemies. The most heavily changed was Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas , handled by Capcom, which officially confirmed removing civilian-killing side missions and sexual occupational content, on top of disabled headshots and muted drug references.
The common thread here is sex, nudity and the most graphic gore, with the core game left relatively untouched.
Every modern Rockstar game has been edited for Japan, so the file-size gap suggests GTA 6 is next.
To be fair, across the years, the Japanese versions only lost specific scenes and effects, the story or most of the mayhem making it what it is remained intact. The game is not banned, unlike in other countries . GTA V in Japan was noticeably trimmed but remained mostly the same. If we go by that record, any cuts to the Japanese release of GTA VI when the game comes out in November would most likely affect the game's sex scenes, nudity and the goriest moments , rather than significantly affect the experience. We will only know the exact list when players get a chance to compare the two builds after release.
Unfortunately, this scenario creates a real headache for anyone in Japan who wants to play through the uncut version. Buying out of region is not as simple as switching to a different store. Sony didn't lock PS5 discs to a specific region, so a Japanese player could run a US or UK disc, but a digital purchase and download code is a separate thing entirely. They're tied to the country on your PlayStation account, which you can't change. Rockstar has already confirmed the GTA 6 PS5 code-in-box is region-locked by account country, while Xbox codes are not . The common workaround is creating a second PSN account set to the US, funded with US gift cards and shared to the main console, which works but it splits your library, trophies and PS Plus across two accounts.
For now, what we know is the file sizes are real, the CERO history is well documented and every modern Rockstar game has received similar if not the exact same treatment.
If you are in Japan and want to play it safe with possible cuts, you'll want to buy an overseas copy, or, you can take this L because you have access to the cheapest PS5 on the market anyway.

articles.t: New Mexico could spend nearly $1.4 million in lost wages as employees skip work for GTA 6
articles.chapeau: A new study says New Mexico could spend about $1.38 million in lost wages as more than 5,700 people may take off work to play Grand Theft Auto Six.
articles.txt:
ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. – A new study says New Mexico could spend about $1.38 million in lost wages as more than 5,700 people may take off work to play Grand Theft Auto Six.
Grand Theft Auto Six comes out later this month after gamers waited 13 years for the new installment.
Amazon Slots conducted a study found more than 5,700 New Mexicans could take the day off for the game’s release on the 19th. The study estimated those callouts would cost the state about $1.38 million in wages.
“I am excited, I’ve been waiting since it’s been announced, I love all the GTA games” said Alejandra Emms who is taking 2 days of paid time off to play the game.
Emms says she estimates to spend about 25 hours playing the anticipated over the course of her two-day gaming vacation,
Anders Hansen, Assistant manager at a local GameStop said people including his customers and friends plan to take time off work for the new game. He noted the game’s anticipation spans demographics.
“It’s not just our regulars or people into video games there’s older people, there’s younger people, it’s generational for sure,” said Hansen.
Researchers used information on what gamers plan to do on release day and matched it with Bureau of Labor Statistics data to estimate lost wages in New Mexico.
Across the country, the study says the game could cost more than $300 million in lost wages.

articles.t: GTA 6 : une fuite révèle une taille différente sur Xbox et PS5 avec un patch envisageable dès le premier jour
articles.chapeau: Une nouvelle fuite chiffre enfin la taille GTA 6 Xbox vs PS5, avec plus de 200 Go en jeu et un calendrier de préchargement déjà calé. Mais ces données contradictoires cachent peut-être un patch day one et d’autres surprises pour le 19 novembre 2026.
articles.txt:
Une nouvelle fuite chiffre enfin la taille GTA 6 Xbox vs PS5, avec plus de 200 Go en jeu et un calendrier de préchargement déjà calé. Mais ces données contradictoires cachent peut-être un patch day one et d’autres surprises pour le 19 novembre 2026.
Les joueurs savaient que GTA 6 serait massif, ils commencent à découvrir à quel point. Une nouvelle fuite côté Xbox Series X|S montre que le prochain jeu de Rockstar Games pourrait occuper bien plus de 200 Go sur le SSD, avec une taille de fichier qui ne colle pas tout à fait à celle annoncée sur PS5 .
Entre les chiffres du Microsoft Store , ceux du PlayStation Store et la note officielle de Rockstar, on voit désormais apparaître plusieurs valeurs différentes pour un même jeu. De quoi alimenter une question qui fâche à l’approche du 19 novembre 2026 : la version Xbox intègre-t-elle déjà un patch day one que la version PS5 ne montre pas encore clairement ?
La fuite part de la DisplayCatalog API de Microsoft, mise en lumière par l’utilisateur Cokymoky puis analysée par Notebookcheck. Le build « global » de GTA 6 sur Xbox affiche ainsi 209,86 Gio, soit environ 225,34 Go, tandis que la version japonaise descend à 208,74 Gio, soit 224,07 Go. Le Xbox Store , lui, affiche 209,86 Go, mais il semble en réalité reprendre la valeur en Gio, plus technique.
Côté PS5 , le compte X PlayStation Game Size a repéré un téléchargement d’environ 210 Go pour l’édition Standard de GTA 6 , chiffre ensuite relayé par Insider Gaming et la presse française. De son côté, Rockstar prévient déjà que le jeu demandera « up to 212 GB of available space, depending on your device ». Autrement dit, l’installation finale pourrait légèrement dépasser les chiffres de préchargement sur les deux consoles.
Première subtilité à comprendre : la différence entre Go et Gio. Les interfaces grand public parlent en gigaoctets (Go), alors que les backends comme l’API de Microsoft utilisent souvent les gibioctets (Gio), un calcul légèrement différent. 209,86 Gio se traduisent ainsi par environ 225 Go « marketing » une fois arrondis, d’où l’écart entre les valeurs visibles selon les stores.
S’ajoute à cela la compression. Notebookcheck rappelle que « because they employ distinct compression methods, Xbox games are often larger than on its rival console ». Résultat : une même version de GTA 6 peut prendre un peu plus de place sur Xbox Series X|S que sur PS5 , même si le contenu est identique. Sur une PS5, avec environ 667 Go réellement utilisables, les 210 à 212 Go du jeu avaleront près d’un tiers du SSD. Sur une Xbox Series S et ses quelque 364 Go libres, GTA 6 pourrait dépasser la moitié de l’espace disponible.
L’écart entre les 210 Go repérés sur PS5 et les ~225 Go issus de l’API Xbox laisse penser que la build Xbox pourrait déjà intégrer un patch day one. Notebookcheck évoque cette possibilité, tout en rappelant qu’aucune taille précise de mise à jour de lancement n’a été détaillée par Rockstar. Dans le doute, les joueurs ont intérêt à viser au moins 230 à 250 Go d’espace libre au moment du préchargement.
Autre détail intrigant, la version japonaise un peu plus légère. GTA 6 y hérite du classement CERO Z (18+) , comme GTA 4 et GTA 5 . Or, plusieurs scènes avaient été coupées dans GTA 5 au Japon. La différence de taille entre le build japonais et le build global pourrait donc refléter une nouvelle fois quelques contenus censurés, sans impact pour les joueurs européens.
Enfin, côté calendrier, les préchargements devraient s’ouvrir autour du 9 novembre au soir sur Xbox et du 10 novembre à minuit local sur PS5, pour une sortie mondiale le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S . Avec plus de 200 Go à télécharger, ceux qui disposent d’une connexion modeste auront tout intérêt à lancer le téléchargement dès que le pré-load sera disponible et à faire un sérieux ménage dans leur bibliothèque avant la date fatidique.

articles.t: GTA 6 build leak hints online multiplayer could arrive earlier than expected
Leaked GTA 6 release date build hints online multiplayer could launch soon
articles.chapeau: Some rumors point to a GTA 6 online mode not launching until later in 2027. However, a data miner leaked code from the release date build alluding to multiplayer features. The profitability of GTA Online raised doubts that Rockstar would be eager to transition players.
articles.txt:
With pre-loads set to begin, data miners are discovering clues about Rockstar ’s anticipated title. PlayStation Game Size found traces of online functionality in the GTA 6 release date build. While a multiplayer mode will not launch on November 19th, it could arrive sooner than anticipated.
An investigation of the PlayStation backend revealed references including “joinSession”, “launchActivity”, and “launchMultiplayerActivity.” These leaked strings indicate gamers can create or join sessions and initiate multiplayer-focused events.
Despite the curious GTA 6 release date code, a sequel to GTA Online could still be many months away. Developers may have prepared to add a multiplayer component seamlessly in the future. Regardless, an extended delay conflicts with a pattern set by GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 .
With the previous Grand Theft Auto , an online mode emerged two weeks after the solo campaign debuted. Meanwhile, Red Dead Redemption 2 saw a beta option surface about a month following the open-world western's release.
On the other hand, GTA Online remains lucrative for Rockstar, and it may hesitate to leave supporters behind. Bloomberg insider Jason Schreier downplayed the chances of the studio announcing a sequel to service in the near future. He later said fans may need to wait until 2027 for co-op missions.
In an interview, Twitch CEO Dan Clancy discussed how the streaming platform would benefit from the game. Still, he explained that an expected GTA 6 Online in 2027 would produce a bigger surge in viewership. Since Rockstar acquired Cfx.re, there is hope for a popular role-playing mode similar to GTA 5 .
The latest leak reminds observers of messages exposed during a Rockstar employee tribunal. Discord logs mentioned a 32-participant multiplayer test session in October 2025. Even if the saga of Jason and Lucia takes priority, an alternative to single-player is planned.
Data miners are on high alert as the November 10th GTA 6 pre-loads commence first in New Zealand at midnight local time. As files become accessible on Xbox and PS5 consoles , more findings seem inevitable.

articles.t: GTA 6 Piracy Claim: 0 Proven PS5 Exploits [2026]
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 piracy headlines vs the record: Zelnick called piracy a fact of life, but no PS5 exploit is confirmed ahead of the Nov. 19 launch.
articles.txt:
Headlines this week say Grand Theft Auto VI could be pirated on PlayStation at launch and that Rockstar’s owner isn’t worried. The on-record material is narrower. LevelUp, The Times and Mashable India all ran versions of the story, and the common thread is a piracy comment from Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick. GTA 6 piracy is a real topic for any big release, but no reporting we can verify shows a working method on PlayStation 5.
The game is scheduled for November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a standard price of $79.99. Rockstar Games is the developer and publisher, and it is a publishing label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Our earlier look at how GTA 6 leaks moved Take-Two’s market value shows how sensitive the stock is to anything touching this launch.
This analysis separates what Zelnick actually said from what the headlines added. It also covers why piracy talk spikes around a launch of this size, what the legal and technical responses he described would involve, and what readers should do about fake files in the meantime. Every claim below traces to the confirmed record. Where the record stops, we say so.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Three outlets framed the story in similar terms. The framing has two parts. First, that Grand Theft Auto VI could be pirated on PlayStation at launch. Second, that the company behind Rockstar is relaxed about it. Both parts read like news, and both are easy to repeat. Neither is confirmed.
The first part is a prediction dressed as a finding. A headline that says a game “could be” pirated is true of nearly every game ever released, which makes it nearly impossible to disprove. It tells readers nothing about whether a jailbreak exists, whether a dump of the game exists, or whether copies would run on retail PlayStation 5 hardware. The reporting we reviewed names no exploit, no method, no pirate server and no unauthorized copy. The fact sheet for this story lists each of those as unconfirmed.
The second part, the idea that Rockstar’s owner is not worried, is a paraphrase of a longer remark. Zelnick did not describe indifference. He described piracy as a continuing issue and said the company would respond with legal and technical work if it became a problem. That is a posture of readiness, which differs from a posture of calm. The gap between the two matters for anyone trying to judge how seriously Take-Two treats the risk.
Editorially, this is a familiar pattern in gaming coverage. A CEO answers a question in an interview, a single line gets lifted, and the line becomes a headline that implies a bigger event. The event here is a speculative one: a piracy scenario that has not happened. Treat the story as a statement of corporate posture, not as evidence of a security failure.
The reporting cites Zelnick discussing piracy in an interview or event account. Two statements are confirmed word for word. The first is short: “Piracy is a fact of life.” The second is longer and carries the real substance of his position.
“It’s not been a non-issue. And in the event that it turns into an issue, we address it the same way every other business does, which is with legal work, and then with technical work, and we’ll have to do both.”
Read slowly, the quote says four things. Piracy exists. It has not been a non-issue for the company. If it escalates, the company will respond. And the response will have two tracks, legal and technical, both running together. Nothing in it says GTA 6 will be pirated. Nothing in it says the company is untroubled. The wording is closer to a risk statement from a company that has dealt with the problem before.
Zelnick also argued that game file sizes, game complexity and the need to connect to Take-Two’s servers can make piracy less useful than piracy of films or music. That is a business argument about the value of a stolen copy. A pirated movie is a self-contained file that plays anywhere. A pirated online game may be a large, partial experience that depends on servers the pirate cannot control. We return to that argument in a later section.
This is not the first time Zelnick’s phrasing has drawn a crowd. We covered Zelnick’s earlier exchange about 15 franchises and 5M+ sales , and the pattern is similar. He answers directly, and the internet compresses the answer.

Sofia Lindström November 8, 2026 14 min read The loudest question hanging over Rockstar’s biggest release is no longer about the map or the trailers. It is about GTA 6 piracy. LevelUp reported that Grand Theft Auto VI could be pirated on PlayStation at launch, while the owner of Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., says it is not worried. The Times and Mashable India ran the same story, and the framing across all three is a possibility, not a proven break.
That distinction matters. Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and digital pre-loading on PS5 is scheduled to begin at midnight local time on November 10. If you want the practical side of that countdown, our guide to the November 10 preload on PS5 and Xbox covers the logistics. This analysis stays on the piracy question: what was said, what is confirmed, and what remains guesswork.
The short version is simple. Nobody has confirmed that GTA VI will be pirated on PlayStation 5 at launch. Nobody has confirmed that a PS5 jailbreak will enable it. And nobody outside Rockstar and Take-Two has confirmed what protection the game ships with. What exists is a CEO who treats piracy as a permanent feature of entertainment and a launch date that is now less than two weeks away.
